descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S17 「养老院第 2–3 步：第 2 天重新打开、第 2 天带新化验的 Save Note，以及最近两次就诊的边界」 Nursing Home steps 2-3: day-2 reopen, day-2 Save Note with a new lab, and the last-two-visits edge

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 Nursing Home (steps 2-3 repeated): pre-round clears at 12 h, encounter at 12 h and note at 18 h. The last two visits, the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed.（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.6；TFA-94699 AC 1 (Nursing Home line)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U12 A one-line summary from today's finished note appears in tomorrow's pre-round with no upload, paste or photo step. It contains nothing the note did not say and appears on that patient only.（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.4；TFA-92591 AC 5；TFA-92591 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U8 Day-2 Save Note with one new lab (creatinine): the new value shows with today's date and its trend as in the prototype (e.g. 'Cr 1.4, ↑ from 1.1'). Yesterday's value stays with yesterday's date. …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.7；UAT 3.3；TFA-94699 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U9 Today's note does not present yesterday's vitals or labs as today's. If no vitals were dictated today, the note says so (3.7). …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Nursing Home resident with a chronic medication list (3 rows), one open task, and visits 1 and 2 completed with generated notes. Visit 1 recorded Cr 1.1 and BP 130/80

When Age 20 h and reopen (day-2 checks). Type pre-round 'Creatinine 1.4 this morning.' with no vitals, press Save Note, then Generate. Then complete visit 3 and age past its note window

Then Day 2: pre-round is empty (12 h), the encounter is gone (12 h) and the note has moved out of the working tab (18 h). Day-2 Save Note: Cr 1.4 shows with today's date and '↑ from 1.1' (Q12), and Cr 1.1 keeps visit 1's date. The Nursing Home note does not present 130/80 as today's and says no vitals were dictated today. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-13 Nursing Home bullet + step 5 (repeat steps 2-3) + 3.3 (both modes) + 3.6 Nursing Home windows + 3.7 + TFA-94699 Nursing Home line / AC 3. The 'visit' definition and two-vs-three visits are Q6; main keeps three. Earlier-visit values appearing in the note with their date are Q14 and are recorded
